title: Relative clauses
lead: Who, which, that, whose, where ile bir ismi tanımlayan yan cümleler; romanından örneklerle.

lessons.title: Relative clause nedir?
lessons.text: Bir ismi tanımlayan ya da onun hakkında bilgi veren yan cümledir. Türkçedeki “-en / -an”, “-dığı / -diği” yapılarının karşılığıdır. İngilizcede tanımlanan ismin hemen ARKASINDAN gelir ve who, which, that, whose, where, when gibi bir kelimeyle başlar.
examples: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
Yan kapıda oturan adam doktor.
I lost the book that you gave me.
Bana verdiğin kitabı kaybettim.
This is the town where I was born.
Burası doğduğum kasaba.

lessons.title: who · which · that
lessons.text: Kişiler için who, eşyalar ve hayvanlar için which kullanılır. That ikisinin yerine de geçebilir ve günlük konuşmada çok yaygındır. Ama virgüllü (ek bilgi veren) cümlelerde that kullanılmaz.
examples: The girl who/that won the race is my sister.
Yarışı kazanan kız kız kardeşim.
The car which/that I bought is red.
Aldığım araba kırmızı.
The dog which/that bit me was huge.
Beni ısıran köpek kocamandı.

lessons.title: whose: sahiplik
lessons.text: whose, “-in … olan / -in -sı” anlamında sahiplik gösterir. Hem kişiler hem eşyalar için kullanılır. Arkasından her zaman bir isim gelir: whose + isim.
examples: That's the boy whose father is a pilot.
Bu, babası pilot olan çocuk.
I met a woman whose car was stolen.
Arabası çalınan bir kadınla tanıştım.
It's a house whose windows are blue.
Pencereleri mavi olan bir ev.

lessons.title: where · when · why
lessons.text: where yer için (in which), when zaman için (on which / in which), why “the reason” ile neden için kullanılır.
examples: This is the café where we first met.
Burası ilk tanıştığımız kafe.
I remember the day when you arrived.
Geldiğin günü hatırlıyorum.
That's the reason why I called you.
Seni aramamın nedeni bu.

lessons.title: Özne mi nesne mi? Zamir ne zaman atılır?
lessons.text: Zamirden sonra hemen fiil geliyorsa zamir cümlenin ÖZNESİDİR ve atılamaz. Zamirden sonra yeni bir özne (I, you, she, the teacher…) geliyorsa zamir NESNEDİR; who / which / that atılabilir. Bu, Türkçedeki “-dığım / -diğin” yapısına denk gelir.
examples: The book (that) I read was great.
Okuduğum kitap harikaydı. (nesne → atılabilir)
The woman (who) we met was friendly.
Tanıştığımız kadın cana yakındı. (nesne → atılabilir)
The man who called you is here.
Seni arayan adam burada. (özne → atılamaz)

lessons.title: Virgüllü – virgülsüz (defining / non-defining)
lessons.text: Virgülsüz cümle hangi kişi ya da şeyden bahsettiğimizi BELİRLER; çıkarırsan anlam eksik kalır. Virgüllü cümle zaten belli olan bir şeye EK BİLGİ ekler; çıkarsan da cümle anlaşılır. Virgüllü cümlede that kullanılmaz ve zamir atılamaz.
examples: My sister who lives in Ankara is a teacher.
Ankara'da yaşayan kız kardeşim öğretmen. (birden fazla kız kardeşim var)
My mother, who is 60, still runs every day.
60 yaşındaki annem hâlâ her gün koşuyor. (tek bir annem var, ek bilgi)
Istanbul, which has two continents, is huge.
İki kıtası olan İstanbul çok büyük.

lessons.title: Edatlarla: in which, the house I live in
lessons.text: Fiil bir edatla kullanılıyorsa (live in, talk to, look for) edat iki yerde durabilir: resmi dilde zamirin önünde (in which, to whom), günlük dilde cümlenin sonunda. Edat önde ise that ve who kullanılmaz; which ya da whom gelir.
examples: The house in which I live is old.
Yaşadığım ev eski. (resmi)
The house (that) I live in is old.
Yaşadığım ev eski. (günlük)
The person to whom I spoke was polite.
Konuştuğum kişi kibardı.

lessons.title: whom
lessons.text: whom, kişi NESNE olduğunda who yerine kullanılan resmi biçimdir. Edattan sonra mutlaka whom gelir (to whom, with whom). Günlük konuşmada genellikle who ya da hiç zamir kullanılmaz.
examples: The man whom I saw was tall.
Gördüğüm adam uzundu. (resmi)
The man I saw was tall.
Gördüğüm adam uzundu. (günlük)
She is the friend with whom I travel.
Birlikte seyahat ettiğim arkadaş o.

lessons.title: which: bütün cümleye gönderme
lessons.text: Virgülden sonra gelen which bazen tek bir isme değil, önceki cümlenin tamamına gönderme yapar (“bu da …”). Burada that kullanılamaz.
examples: He was late again, which made me angry.
Yine geç kaldı, bu da beni kızdırdı.
It rained all day, which was a pity.
Bütün gün yağmur yağdı, bu da üzücüydü.

lessons.title: Kısaltılmış relative clause (-ing / -ed)
lessons.text: Zamir özne ise cümle kısaltılabilir. Etken anlamda fiil -ing alır (who is sitting → sitting), edilgen anlamda üçüncü hâl kullanılır (which was made → made).
examples: The girl sitting by the window is my cousin.
Pencerenin yanında oturan kız kuzenim.
The cars made in this factory are cheap.
Bu fabrikada üretilen arabalar ucuz.
Anyone wanting tickets should call now.
Bilet isteyen herkes hemen aramalı.

items.q: The woman ___ lives next door is a nurse.
items.why: Kişi + hemen ardından fiil (lives) → özne → who.

items.q: I bought a phone ___ has a great camera.
That's the man ___ dog bit me.
items.why: “köpeği beni ısıran adam” → sahiplik → whose + isim.

items.q: This is the park ___ we play football.
I'll never forget the day ___ I met you.
The students ___ passed the exam were happy.
The cake ___ my mum made was delicious.
items.why: Eşya (cake) → which. Nesne olduğu için atılabilir de: the cake my mum made.

items.q: She has a brother ___ name is Ali.
Is this the bag ___ you lost?
The hotel ___ we stayed was near the sea.
items.why: Kaldığımız yer → where. (which kullanırsan sonuna “at” gerekir: which we stayed at.)

items.q: My grandfather, ___ is 85, still drives.
items.why: Virgüllü cümlede that kullanılmaz; kişi → who.

items.q: Paris, ___ is the capital of France, is beautiful.
items.why: Virgüllü + şehir (şey) → which. Virgüllü cümlede that olmaz.

items.q: He forgot my birthday, ___ really upset me.
The person to ___ I spoke was very helpful.
items.why: Edattan (to) sonra kişi için whom gelir.

items.q: That's the reason ___ I'm late.
A dictionary is a book ___ gives the meanings of words.
I know a girl ___ father is a famous singer.
items.why: whose (sahiplik) ile who's (= who is) karışmasın: “babası şarkıcı olan”.

items.q: The year ___ I finished school was 2020.
Do you know anyone ___ can fix computers?
The film ___ we watched last night was boring.
items.why: Nesne (we watched) → zamir atılabilir: the film we watched. (which / that da olur.)

sets.title: Zamir atılabilir mi?
sets.hint: Parantezdeki kelimeyi çıkarırsak cümle doğru olur mu?

items.q: The book (that) I'm reading is exciting.
items.why: that'tan sonra yeni özne (I) var → nesne → atılabilir.

items.q: The man (who) helped me was kind.
items.why: who'dan sonra hemen fiil (helped) var → özne → atılamaz.

items.q: The people (who) we met in Rome were friendly.
items.why: who'dan sonra özne (we) var → nesne → atılabilir.

items.q: The bus (which) goes to the airport is late.
This is the song (that) I love most.
My father, (who) works in a bank, is tired.
items.why: Virgüllü cümlede zamir asla atılmaz (ayrıca burada özne).

items.q: The girl (whose) bag was stolen called the police.
The house (that) they bought is very old.
The teacher (who) teaches us English is from London.
Everything (that) she said was true.

sets.title: Virgül: tanımlayıcı mı, ek bilgi mi?

items.q: Annem tek; yaşını ek bilgi olarak söylüyoruz.
options: My mother, who is 50, is a doctor.
My mother who is 50 is a doctor.
My mother, that is 50, is a doctor.
items.answer: My mother, who is 50, is a doctor.
items.why: Tek bir annen var → ek bilgi → virgüllü ve who.

items.q: Hangi öğrencilerden bahsettiğimizi belirtiyoruz.
options: Students, who study hard, pass exams.
Students who study hard pass exams.
Students, that study hard, pass exams.
items.answer: Students who study hard pass exams.
items.why: Sadece çok çalışan öğrenciler → tanımlayıcı → virgül yok.

items.q: Ankara hakkında ek bilgi.
options: Ankara which is the capital is big.
Ankara, that is the capital, is big.
Ankara, which is the capital, is big.
items.answer: Ankara, which is the capital, is big.
items.why: Tek bir Ankara var → ek bilgi → virgüller + which (that olmaz).

items.q: Birçok arabam var; dün aldığımdan bahsediyorum.
options: The car that I bought yesterday is blue.
The car, that I bought yesterday, is blue.
The car, I bought yesterday, is blue.
items.answer: The car that I bought yesterday is blue.

items.q: Doğru olanı seç.
options: My best friend, who lives in Izmir, is visiting me.
My best friend, that lives in Izmir, is visiting me.
My best friend, lives in Izmir, is visiting me.
items.answer: My best friend, who lives in Izmir, is visiting me.
items.why: En iyi arkadaş tek → ek bilgi → virgül + who.

items.q: Doğru olanı seç.
options: People, who smoke, damage their health.
People who smoke damage their health.
People which smoke damage their health.
items.answer: People who smoke damage their health.
items.why: Sigara içen insanlar (hepsi değil) → tanımlayıcı → virgülsüz, kişi → who.

items.q: Doğru olanı seç.
options: The Nile, which is very long, flows into the sea.
The Nile which is very long flows into the sea.
The Nile, that is very long, flows into the sea.
items.answer: The Nile, which is very long, flows into the sea.
items.why: Tek bir Nil → ek bilgi → virgül + which.

items.q: Doğru olanı seç.
options: He passed the exam, that surprised everyone.
He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
He passed the exam which surprised everyone.
items.answer: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.

items.q: The man which lives here is my uncle.
options: The man who lives here is my uncle.
The man which lives here is my uncle.
The man where lives here is my uncle.
items.answer: The man who lives here is my uncle.

items.q: This is the book who I told you about.
options: This is the book who I told you about.
This is the book which I told you about.
This is the book whose I told you about.
items.answer: This is the book which I told you about.
items.why: Eşya için who değil which (ya da that / hiç).

items.q: The girl who her brother is my friend is here.
options: The girl whose brother is my friend is here.
The girl who her brother is my friend is here.
The girl who's brother is my friend is here.
items.answer: The girl whose brother is my friend is here.

items.q: The film that I watched it was funny.
options: The film that I watched it was funny.
The film that I watched was funny.
The film I watched it was funny.
items.answer: The film that I watched was funny.
items.why: that zaten filmi gösteriyor; ayrıca “it” eklenmez.

items.q: The city where I live in is small.
options: The city where I live in is small.
The city where I live is small.
The city which I live is small.
items.answer: The city where I live is small.
items.why: where zaten “in which” demek; sonuna in eklenmez. (Ya da: the city which I live in.)

items.q: My father, that is a teacher, loves books.
options: My father, who is a teacher, loves books.
My father, that is a teacher, loves books.
My father that is a teacher loves books.
items.answer: My father, who is a teacher, loves books.

items.q: The people who works here are nice.
options: The people who works here are nice.
The people who work here are nice.
The people which work here are nice.
items.answer: The people who work here are nice.
items.why: Fiil, zamirin gösterdiği isme uyar: people → work.

items.q: I have a friend who he speaks Spanish.
options: I have a friend who he speaks Spanish.
I have a friend he speaks Spanish.
I have a friend who speaks Spanish.
items.answer: I have a friend who speaks Spanish.

items.q: The day which we met was rainy.
options: The day when we met was rainy.
The day where we met was rainy.
The day which we met was rainy.
items.answer: The day when we met was rainy.
items.why: Zaman için when (ya da: the day on which / the day we met).

items.q: She won the prize, that made her parents proud.
options: She won the prize, that made her parents proud.
She won the prize, which made her parents proud.
She won the prize, what made her parents proud.
items.answer: She won the prize, which made her parents proud.

sets.title: Cümleleri birleştir
sets.hint: İki cümleyi relative clause ile tek cümle yap.

items.q: I have a friend. She speaks five languages.
answers: I have a friend who speaks five languages.
I have a friend that speaks five languages.

items.q: This is the bike. I bought it last week.
answers: This is the bike which I bought last week.
This is the bike that I bought last week.
This is the bike I bought last week.
items.why: it → which / that; nesne olduğu için atılabilir. “it” tekrar yazılmaz.

items.q: That's the woman. Her son is a doctor.
answers: That's the woman whose son is a doctor.
That is the woman whose son is a doctor.

items.q: We visited the village. My grandmother was born there.
answers: We visited the village where my grandmother was born.
We visited the village in which my grandmother was born.
We visited the village which my grandmother was born in.
We visited the village that my grandmother was born in.
We visited the village my grandmother was born in.

items.q: The man is a famous actor. He is talking to Ali.
answers: The man who is talking to Ali is a famous actor.
The man that is talking to Ali is a famous actor.
The man talking to Ali is a famous actor.
items.why: Relative clause tanımladığı ismin hemen arkasına gelir: The man who is talking to Ali …

items.q: My brother lives in Berlin. He is an engineer. (ek bilgi)
answers: My brother, who lives in Berlin, is an engineer.
My brother, who is an engineer, lives in Berlin.

items.q: The cake was delicious. You made it.
answers: The cake which you made was delicious.
The cake that you made was delicious.
The cake you made was delicious.

items.q: I remember the summer. We went to Antalya then.
answers: I remember the summer when we went to Antalya.
I remember the summer we went to Antalya.

items.q: The students were tired. They had worked all night.
answers: The students who had worked all night were tired.
The students that had worked all night were tired.

items.q: He didn't call me. That made me sad.
answers: He didn't call me, which made me sad.
He did not call me, which made me sad.

items.q: This is the teacher. I told you about her.
answers: This is the teacher who I told you about.
This is the teacher that I told you about.
This is the teacher I told you about.
This is the teacher whom I told you about.
This is the teacher about whom I told you.
items.why: her → who / whom; edat sonda kalabilir ya da öne gelir (about whom).

items.q: Istanbul is a big city. It has 16 million people. (ek bilgi)
answers: Istanbul, which has 16 million people, is a big city.
